Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 318, "heading": "XIX JEAN VALJEAN SE VENGE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u318-r0030", "target": "Он застегнул сюртук, вернул военную жёсткость между лопатками, повернулся кругом, скрестил руки, подпирая подбородок одной из них, и зашагал в сторону Рынка. Жан Вальжан провожал его глазами. Сделав несколько шагов, Жавер обернулся и крикнул Жану Вальжану:", "source_sha256": "65ee301e61040f6e6d96ced416f2854e74924e53c0afb8bbee5b75fc53de31d6", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u318-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "03315e9d76c36506517061f74b4d618debc0b27c9831e1dd5138c309bab55fa1"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u318-r0031", "target": "— Вы мне надоели. Убейте меня лучше.", "source_sha256": "27267c17b9faa3256264101db7d485ea0fc99ceb84b4adc747a5a9a4bd32fc57", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u318-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "24f27bb6b7dfbb677770305ed8a35aae59dae04392714d9907bcd78622c6dc1a"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 5, "book": 1, "chapter": 19, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u318-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Javert ne s’apercevait pas lui-même qu’il ne tutoyait plus Jean Valjean :", "sha256": "7152093f16d9ca8df1040cb4a2c2ef94791ccbf0c4328a4f1207adc9128a2af0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Allez-vous-en, dit Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "3d86c4023ce0c3b3012756aacce8c5842fdcba59f6a3b8a48b56b8c297c5d066", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Javert s’éloigna à pas lents. Un moment après, il tourna l’angle de la rue des Prêcheurs.", "sha256": "91bdad3d518cdf248ed749275e57f39e83fdb5f0258cdf0688728711b41728ba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quand Javert eut disparu, Jean Valjean déchargea le pistolet en l’air.", "sha256": "98daad8be73a87ec301dc770fce54d9a94ac399f852febdfe7cca0436212aa67", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis il rentra dans la barricade et dit :", "sha256": "eeaf3118c7524c29ed3b007ea2453715bba99551d17b151f071caca6910d97ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est fait.", "sha256": "da4bc6840a2f3ae7c6d3b1bb62264c3becfb5e3e67d67d3198bf1b5afcf0dd57", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cependant voici ce qui s’était passé :", "sha256": "eab101959e051d3faa9596dac31ae47de7243f5f0d4b3c0d591ee724bca1f96f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius, plus occupé du dehors que du dedans, n’avait pas jusque-là regardé attentivement l’espion garrotté au fond obscur de la salle basse.", "sha256": "658479af6c5512e18a9e58d62af37fa6b465f2f8ef2fa8f19497176858ad563f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quand il le vit au grand jour, enjambant la barricade pour aller mourir, il le reconnut. Un souvenir subit lui entra dans l’esprit. Il se rappela l’inspecteur de la rue de Pontoise, et les deux pistolets qu’il lui avait remis et dont il s’était servi, lui Marius, dans cette barricade même ; et non seulement il se rappela la figure, mais il se rappela le nom.", "sha256": "c8bf2ab92e9a8d080368a4f534ab2f8ba9895eaecda0218ce3211e44afc4f6e0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ce souvenir pourtant était brumeux et trouble comme toutes ses idées. Ce ne fut pas une affirmation qu’il se fit, ce fut une question qu’il s’adressa : — Est-ce que ce n’est pas là cet inspecteur de police qui m’a dit s’appeler Javert ?", "sha256": "2351a1c3b040398617469394e35598dd0a8ea6b7d524bdd829944f90e6992f81", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Peut-être était-il encore temps d’intervenir pour cet homme ? Mais il fallait d’abord savoir si c’était bien ce Javert.", "sha256": "51d3a3626344b4f6c07970112dc86b1a0c559dbb923eec9f0ea3067ebb79ec2a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius interpella Enjolras qui venait de se placer à l’autre bout de la barricade.", "sha256": "f36ee61a67dbf35e4d902a12f494f953fbe5d82bbb067053b4725891df964e48", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Enjolras !", "sha256": "eba9d0ade1c956b223f9286cbef685db3d11e7e7312ea6beeb0774e47e9c9ac1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi ?", "sha256": "61a0fac8ae488c6bc653f1215cdda5ca31b778598be9273b7ab3b579855004d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment s’appelle cet homme-là ?", "sha256": "bbc77c239c3c08220033dd1c671058922973d1c04c8790582e478b5e6de070ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui ?", "sha256": "a6c7e94377c5e480a2000a6fb126a36f3d18d4a1a0be62438b0873280bf55558", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’agent de police. Sais-tu son nom ?", "sha256": "f895ed23913444e70ad79112c349caa3ae2465d9545c14a5402f061d624f385b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute. Il nous l’a dit.", "sha256": "1bced261b4667367ad29a747364b4cd0eda60b1340d7ee2a2a974cda8ab22197", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment s’appelle-t-il ?", "sha256": "aacce3fdbf478e081c5dc0a17de9e3a626c246bdf32aee8b4cbb44423d49cee6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Javert.", "sha256": "6dbd461c13f1dbe129b3e42fee169c46440ded0f4253a490707279ec87804e4e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius se dressa.", "sha256": "1c38a6aac9d386a870b33d30e1833852d8f90bdd371e0cf76351d2c2f3a3b165", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "En ce moment on entendit le coup de pistolet.", "sha256": "9f5d00eea7d18719bf0803dc44008b8893ef97d3e860dfb40948f87ae5342441", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "Jean Valjean reparut et cria : C’est fait.", "sha256": "b79e37e430b05d9c2d44dc2c995501df47bd466561f88ba30040a7eae4ef1c38", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u318-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Un froid sombre traversa le cœur de Marius.", "sha256": "6daecca2cbb86479918b349bbbfb47eb2df40c323d004c58f1ccdba86b1cf4bf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
